steps.prompt_exact: Can you make me a tiny roommate freezer board I can save as one HTML file, for tracking shared frozen meals, remaining portions, expiration urgency, and who has claimed what?
steps.response_exact:
Your HTML file is ready

freezer_board
HTML

It is a completely standalone dashboard that uses browser storage to persist the dashboard data locally across page refreshes.

Features Included:

Real-time Metrics: Tracks total active meal containers and remaining individual portions.

Urgency Coding: Items automatically sort by high, medium, or low expiration urgency.

Claim System: Roommates can type their names to claim individual portions or items dynamically.

Instant Filtering: A live search bar handles queries for meal names, creators, or who has claimed what.

Data Persistence: Everything automatically saves to the browser's localStorage instantly.
steps.response_summary: Gemini generated one standalone freezer_board.html artifact and described its localStorage persistence, urgency sorting, claim system, filtering, meal count, and portion metrics.
